verdict.rationale: Dover documents a per-job interview plan where each stage has its own interviewers, duration, meeting type, email templates and feedback form. Feedback forms are created once and reused across stages so every interviewer scores the same way. The docs do not describe a reusable question bank, since AI-suggested questions are generated per candidate, and they do not describe per-interviewer focus areas within a stage. Missing for 10: a reusable question bank attached to the plan, per-interviewer focus-area assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused

citations.quote: Each stage can have its own interviewers, duration, meeting type, email templates, and feedback form.
Create a form once, assign it to an interview stage, and every interviewer scores candidates the same way.
It shows the candidate's details, their resume, and the feedback form assigned to the interview stage.
